WITH upd AS (
    UPDATE project_intake_runs
    SET error_message = $2,
        last_failed_workflow = $3,
        last_failed_node = $4,
        last_error_at = NOW(),
        error_count = COALESCE(error_count, 0) + 1,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE run_id = $1
    RETURNING
        run_id,
        intake_page_id,
        project_page_id,
        error_message,
        error_count
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM upd), $1) AS run_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT intake_page_id FROM upd), NULL) AS intake_page_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT project_page_id FROM upd), NULL) AS project_page_id,
    $2 AS error_message,
    COALESCE((SELECT error_count FROM upd), 0) AS error_count;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        intake_page_id,
        project_page_id,
        status
    FROM project_intake_runs
    WHERE status NOT IN ('Done', 'COMPLETED')
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AS run_id,
    (SELECT intake_page_id FROM latest) AS intake_page_id,
    (SELECT project_page_id FROM latest) AS project_page_id,
    (SELECT status FROM latest) AS status;

INSERT INTO project_events (
    run_id,
    event_type,
    workflow_name,
    node_name,
    severity,
    message,
    payload
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    $7::jsonb
)
RETURNING id;
